definitions.explanation: Paying careful attention to every detail; leaving nothing overlooked; comprehensive and complete in preparation or execution.

examples.japanese: {周到|しゅうとう}な⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{周到|しゅうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}った→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: He carefully worked out the plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧{周到|しゅうとう}な⟦プレゼンテーション→プレゼンテーション：29053_purezenteeshon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}した→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: The meticulously prepared presentation captivated the audience.

notes:
{周到|しゅうとう} describes careful, thorough attention to detail.

FORMS:
- {周|しゅう} (around, complete) + {到|とう} (arrive, reach)
- Literally: reaching all around; covering everything

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周到|しゅうとう}な⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: thorough preparation
- {周到|しゅうとう}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: meticulous plan
- ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧{周到|しゅうとう}: thoroughly prepared
- {周到|しゅうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to carefully work out

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND:
⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧{周到|しゅうとう} - thoroughly prepared (very common expression)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{杜撰|ずさん}→杜撰：09064_zusan⟧: sloppy, careless
